capability.summary: Find words related by meaning to one natural-language idea
capability.description: Calls Datamuse's fixed words endpoint with ml=<query> to return words related in meaning, preserving the provider's scored result list in the shared JSON envelope. It is semantic word association, not dictionary definition lookup.
capability.problem_space: Meaning-based word discovery from one idea; not authoritative definitions, translation, spelling correction, or arbitrary web search.

constraint.io_signature: Input: one meaning query at CLI position 1. Output: shared JSON envelope containing Datamuse word-score objects, URL, and HTTP status. HTTP 2xx/3xx responses produce a success envelope; HTTP 4xx/5xx responses produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit; request exceptions also produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit.
accepted_inputs: one natural-language idea or phrase used as the Datamuse ml query
constraint.output_shape: HTTP 2xx/3xx: {status: "success", tool: string, url: string, http_status: integer, result: object|string}. HTTP 4xx/5xx: {status: "error", tool: string, url: string, http_status: integer, result: object|string}, exit 1. Request exception: {status: "error", tool: string, message: string}, exit 1.
limitations: fixed GET https://api.datamuse.com/words with query ml=<argument>
no relation selector, max count, score threshold, pagination, spelling, pronunciation, or batch input; all CLI arguments after position 1 are ignored
wrapper does not locally parse, sort, paginate, or truncate the returned word list
missing input is not validated and the ml parameter is omitted from the request
HTTP 2xx/3xx responses produce a success envelope; HTTP 4xx/5xx responses produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit; request exceptions also produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit.

output_contract.description: Shared JSON envelope containing Datamuse semantically related word-score objects, URL, and HTTP status.

json_schema.description: Native JSON representation only; no field or task-delivery guarantee.

intent_tags: use Datamuse to discover associated words
negative_intents: look up a word definition or pronunciation
translate text or search arbitrary web pages
